summary: A U.S. senator has committed to prioritizing DC statehood, while advocacy groups are highlighting recent federal interventions in the District—including a federal takeover and National Guard deployment—as evidence for why statehood is urgent. DC Vote is also urging lawmakers to reject measures that would restrict DC's fiscal autonomy. Without statehood, D.C. cannot spend its own local tax revenue until Congress approves its budget, and Congress can override any law the District passes.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
